references.text: Jesus noticed that power went out from him when the woman with bleeding touched him, paralleling how power went out from him and healed everyone in Luke 6:19.
The Lord's power was present so that Jesus could heal, reflecting how power went out from him and healed all.
Jesus said, "Someone touched me, for I noticed that power went out from me," which directly parallels the idea that power went out from him through touch.
People asked to touch the edge of Jesus' cloak, and all who touched him were healed—the same motif as in Luke 6:19 where the crowd sought to touch him to be healed.
In Mark's parallel account, all who had diseases threw themselves over Jesus to touch him, reflecting the crowd's desire to touch him in Luke 6:19.
Wherever Jesus went, they laid the sick in the marketplaces and asked to touch even the fringe of his cloak, and all who touched him were healed—the same pattern of touch and healing.
People carried the sick into the streets so that Peter's shadow might fall on them, a parallel to the belief that physical closeness to God's power through the apostles could heal.
God performed extraordinary miracles through Paul, so that handkerchiefs and aprons from him healed the sick—an extension of the healing power that went out from Jesus.
The immediate context where large crowds came to hear Jesus and be healed of their diseases, and those troubled by unclean spirits were healed.
